title: Spatial Joins & Predicates
interviewAnswer: A spatial join combines rows based on geometric relations such as within, contains, intersects or nearest instead of equality on a key.
why: Spatial joins are the geographic analogue of a core relational data operation.
intuition: Infer a region from whether a customer point lies inside a polygon instead of requiring a region_id.
deepDive: Predicates have different boundary semantics and can create one-to-many matches; distance joins require compatible coordinate systems.
commonMistakes: Using intersects when within is required.
production: Validate geometry, CRS, cardinality and boundary rules before downstream aggregation.
workedExample: Attach neighborhood demographics to store locations with a point-in-polygon join.
